business_problem: A&F Co.’s traditional, disparate infrastructure systems were limiting its ability to initiate customer innovation strategies and more personalized digital journeys.
solution_summary: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. used Azure Kubernetes Service, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI to move core workloads and data onto a modern cloud platform. A&F Co.’s traditional, disparate infrastructure systems were limiting its ability to initiate customer innovation strategies and more personalized digital journeys. Key implementation elements included Azure Kubernetes Service runs containerized application services at scale on Azure; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Power BI delivers reports and dashboards to business users; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure. Legacy applications and data are moved onto an Azure-based platform, where standardized services, integrations, and analytics support the new operating model.
